name: memory_test_v1
description: NebulonMind agent benchmark: retrieval accuracy, tool selection, answer correctness and hallucination behaviour. Each item carries a 'seed' text stored into the user's memory before evaluation (deduplicated), an 'expected_memory' used to score retrieval, and an 'expected_answer' used to score the final answer.
